data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has applied a similar approach at the current year end to that applied at the previous year end in establishing the technical provisions for claims outstanding reserves and reinsurers' share thereof. Included within net claims incurred of GBP 7.2m (2018: GBP 68.9m) is an improvement of GBP 1.0m (2018: deterioration of GBP 3.3m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to close of 2016 & Prior years
prior_year_events.impact_description: 2016 & Prior years of account closed by way of an external reinsurance to close transaction and the brought forward technical provisions were removed from the Syndicate's opening balances.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were GBP 321.993m. Using the gross claims development table for the remaining 2017 year of account, gross prior-year development during 2019 amounted to a deterioration (strengthening) of approximately GBP 7.824m (2.4% of opening gross reserves). The managing agent's narrative notes a net improvement of GBP 1.0m driven by favourable developments in Property, Aviation and Marine and Professional Indemnity / Property binders, with partially offsetting adverse development elsewhere. The year was also impacted by the prior reinsurance-to-close of the 2016 & prior years which materially reduced opening balances.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 7.2m (2018: GBP 68.9m) is an improvement of GBP 1.0m (2018: deterioration of GBP 3.3m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.
Actual vs expected claims development was favourable in the period driven by the Professional Indemnity and Property Binders classes.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' line was provided. Gross prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (2017 column) and yields a gross strengthening of GBP 7.824m. The managing agent's text quotes a NET improvement of GBP 1.0m; RITC of 2016 & prior materially reduced opening gross balances (RITC adjustment GBP 251.160m) which distorts year-on-year comparisons. Users should note the net/gross inconsistency and the RITC impact.
